title: responses schema import: suppress expected union-inference warnings only by exact message during module-level schema build
answers: Importing mlflow.types.responses prints 'Union type hint is inferred as AnyType' warnings into my app's root logging; how do I silence it?
Where does the module-level ResponsesAgentRequest schema get built, and what logger does its type-hint inference use?
I want to add another expected warning filter during schema construction without hiding ordinary union warnings elsewhere; how is that done?
body:
Path: mlflow/types/responses.py module-level code builds the request/response JSON schemas for ResponsesAgentRequest and related ResponsesAgentStreamEvent types by calling _infer_schema_from_type_hint at import time; this is the path every `import mlflow.types.responses` takes.
Rule: wrap import-time schema construction in suppress_logs("mlflow.types.type_hints", filter_regex=...) from mlflow/utils/logging_utils.py:suppress_logs, combined with MlflowEventsAndWarningsBehaviorGlobally, and filter with the exact expected-message regex _EXPECTED_UNION_INFERENCE_WARNING in mlflow/types/responses.py. Keep the regex anchored to the full message so only those known messages are dropped.
Symptom: applications using custom root logging (host-managed logging) saw the two expected union-inference warnings every time mlflow.types.responses was imported, even though nothing was wrong.
Constraints: applies only while the module-level schema is constructed at import. Other union-inference warnings raised elsewhere in mlflow.types.type_hints must still be emitted. Do not replace this with a global disable of the type_hints logger.
applies: mlflow/types/responses.py import-time schema construction and its log/warning filtering; not runtime ResponsesAgent request handling.
says: Application startup logs are cluttered with union type inference warning messages.
Spurious type hint warnings appear in the console every time the package loads.
Silence expected schema warnings on startup without hiding genuine warning logs elsewhere.
Filter out benign initialization warnings from host managed application logging output.
search: Import-time schema construction in mlflow/types/responses.py suppresses expected union-inference warnings by anchoring filters to exact messages rather than disabling loggers globally. Module-level construction for ResponsesAgentRequest and ResponsesAgentStreamEvent wraps _infer_schema_from_type_hint using suppress_logs("mlflow.types.type_hints", filter_regex=...) and _EXPECTED_UNION_INFERENCE_WARNING. This prevents benign warning spam in applications using custom root logging without hiding legitimate union-inference warnings elsewhere in mlflow.types.type_hints. The suppression applies strictly during import-time schema creation and not to runtime request handling.
